scope: Public-source research and bounded HTTP range inspection of public stock weights. No private conversations, private audit reports, local model files, GPU inference, or model/service changes.

public_checkpoint_inspection.scope: All shard headers; only language-layer input/post-attention norms and GDN A_log/dt_bias values. No MLP/attention matrix values or activations inspected. No inference or edits.

official_benchmarks.limitations: Publisher results. Harness, precision, sampling, output caps, task revision, and scoring differ from local Marathon evaluations.

external_benchmarks.limitations: Different tasks measure different capabilities. These are not failure diagnoses or evidence for a specific circuit. CritPt v1 has documented benchmark-quality concerns.

behavior_evidence.finding: Official instructions discuss presence penalty as a repetition mitigation with possible performance costs; lower effort can increase retries in agentic work. Neither establishes a loop prevalence for the local checkpoint.

Publisher BF16 five-seed results: TB2.1 69.21 to 72.13; LiveCodeBench v6 76.76 to 81.71; IFBench 73.53 to 72.07; AIME2026 98.67 to 96.00. Uses RL and on-policy distillation, not a sparse hand edit. Results demonstrate tradeoffs and are not assumed to describe the deployed Swift version.

Publisher reports 37.2% mean per-benchmark reasoning-token reduction; macro accuracy 86.6 to 85.8. Looping 0.06% to 0.05% and truncation 0.51% to 0.34%, equal-weight across benchmarks under its protocol with large generation caps. These rates do not estimate Marathon loop prevalence.
Publisher BF16 vs mixed NVFP4/FP8: GPQA88.92/88.01, IFBench80.07/78.93. Calibration and mixed precision matter; not a controlled measurement of IQ4_XS.

related_intervention_research.name: TACT
related_intervention_research.reported_results: SWE-bench Verified 67.0 to 73.3; TB2.0 30.3 to 36.0; CLAW-Eval pass@3 55.9 to 61.5. Authors report an average +5.8 percentage points across these metrics.
related_intervention_research.method: Contrastive residual-stream axes for overthinking and overacting, selected layers and conditional activation intervention.
related_intervention_research.limitations: Dynamic activation steering is not equivalent to a sparse static weight patch; no independent replication done here. Do not transfer layer indices or axes unchanged.

related_intervention_research.name: AdaRAS
related_intervention_research.tested_model: Main results on Qwen3-1.7B, not Qwen3.8-27B
related_intervention_research.method: Correct/incorrect trace contrasts select sparse MLP neuron activations for adaptive intervention.
related_intervention_research.limitations: Supports neuron-localization experiments, not a known list of beneficial 27B neuron edits.

related_intervention_research.name: Manifold Steering
related_intervention_research.method: Activation intervention along an overthinking direction projected onto a low-dimensional subspace.
related_intervention_research.limitations: Stronger intervention can reduce accuracy. Not demonstrated here on Qwen3.8-27B.

original_weight_space_result.edit: 64 MLP down-projection columns in each of layers 15 and 19; 131072 addressed entries, 130188 BF16 bitwise changes.
original_weight_space_result.diagnosis: Final log reports 576 of 579 practice rescues were originally truncated. Reports dose-response, isolated-layer and norm-matched random controls.
original_weight_space_result.interpretation: Strong evidence for rescuing a specific failure under that protocol; not proof that editing an arbitrary 0.016% of another model improves reasoning.

candidate_experiment.priority: Use public/synthetic matched productive-vs-unproductive reasoning and action traces, with exact model revision and serving settings fixed.
candidate_experiment.local_status_context: STATUS.md reports deployed Swift merge, no reasoning loops in prior public-task audit, and 58/58 successful short explicit-rule tasks obeying the rule. Long-task generalization remains open. This research did not open underlying traces.
candidate_experiment.first_localization: Collect residual states and MLP activations at selected decision points across all 64 layers. Rank discriminative directions/neurons on development data; test causality with reversible interventions on separate validation tasks.
candidate_experiment.weight_candidate: Only after causal validation, test a small selected-column MLP down_proj edit in a separate checkpoint. No specific layer or neuron is currently established as a target.
candidate_experiment.success: Improved held-out correctness, not just shorter outputs; report completion, reasoning length, failure rates and regressions separately.
candidate_experiment.stop: Do not proceed to permanent edits if no reproducible failure or no causal benefit is found.
